blocks.title: Age of Empires is still the cleanest loop
blocks.dek: Research note: the live Age franchise in 2026 is not nostalgia on a shelf. It is a still-updating strategy network: AoE II balance and naval changes, AoE IV expansions, Mythology pantheons, console paths, esports, and a huge player base still practicing the gather-build-advance loop.
